scope: Current evaluator contract and CPU precision validation. No historical table values or experimental artifacts were modified, and equality with historical results is not established.
coverage: Actual Quantus PixelFlipping on a three-channel synthetic image, float32 and float64
Configured logit and softmax scoring, each with its own true original-image baseline
Constructor retains model parameter dtype and exact values; every forward uses the requested dtype
Six post-step prediction CSV rows with channel/spatial feature fractions and nonzero initial score drops
Right-endpoint drop integration and budget indexing; final partial step weighted by actual width

curve_contract.name: post_step_true_baseline_right_sum_v1
curve_contract.baseline: Independent unperturbed target score, with the same per-metric softmax setting as perturbation evaluation
curve_contract.fractions: min(step*features_in_step,C*H*W)/(C*H*W); number of returned post-step scores must match the geometry
curve_contract.drop_at_percent: Drop at the last completed perturbation within the requested budget, zero before the first step
curve_contract.auc_at_percent: Sum of drop_i times the actual feature-fraction increment through completed steps within the budget, without dividing by the requested percentage
curve_contract.auc_at_100: Mean drop for equal step widths; weighted right-endpoint sum if the final step is shorter
curve_contract.csv: Post-step rows only, steps1..n, with explicit initial_prediction, feature_fraction, Quantus version, and metric_contract

historical_limit: Published Hidden Monotonicity table values remain published-source evidence. Deterministic fixtures validate the current implementation, but the original image campaign has not been rerun and its scalar outputs and exact environment are unavailable here.
